judge.rationale: The candidate implements the basic happy path of listing conversations over WebSocket off the per-session lock, but violates several core requirements and explicit decisions in the issue. First, it names the frames and types `list_sessions` / `session_list` (`ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionListMessage`, `sessions`) instead of the specified `list_conversations` / `conversation_list` (`ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationListMessage`, `ConversationSummary`, `conversations`). Second, it completely omits the `transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in flag, the `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED` error code, and `StoreCannotList`, instead returning an empty list `sessions: []` when `listFor` is absent—the exact behavior the ticket explicitly forbade. Third, its validator accepts `limit: 0` and `limit > 200` (which the ticket requires rejecting as invalid outside 1–200), and it logs `error.message` on store failures despite the requirement to avoid logging store details. Finally, it misses the required updates to `example/full-config.ts`, `docs/getting-started.md`, and `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, while leaving `.lore/dod.md` in the tree.
